verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a SaaS immigration platform, but the evidence describes only human case managers, attorneys and in-house experts handling tasks, plus digital forms and tracking. No AI assistant is documented. Human-delivered service and automated reminders are adjacent features and do not count as delegating to a built-in AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
